description: Response format for the blind Devanagari transcription pass (EVAL-003).

fields.item_id: must match a candidate_id in candidate-manifest.jsonl
fields.human_transcription: exactly what is visibly drawn, letter for letter, Unicode preserved. Empty if status is cannot_read.
fields.notes: free text; required when status is ambiguous

IMPORTANT: These readings become the reference for scoring checkers. They do NOT become project ground truth about what the sign 'really' says — see HUMAN-REVIEW-GUIDE.md.
